command:
set -eu
cat /proc/sys/kernel/random/boot_id
cat /proc/uptime
systemctl show -p Version
systemctl is-active systemd-journald ssh docker systemd-networkd systemd-resolved cloudflared bussassistent-backup.timer
systemctl list-timers bussassistent-backup.timer --no-pager
dpkg --audit
test ! -e /run/reboot-required
apt-cache policy linux-image-generic
systemd-analyze cat-config systemd/journald.conf | grep -E "^ForwardToWall="
